senses.gloss: लश् cl. 10. P. लाशयति, to exercise an art, Dhātup. xxxiii, 55 (v.l. for लस्).

लष् (cf. √ लस्) cl. 1. 4.P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxi, 23; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 70) लषति, ˚ते, लष्यति, ˚ते (pf. ललाष, लेषे; aor. अलाषीत् or अलषीत्, अलषिष्ट; fut. लषिता; ˚षिष्यति, ˚ते; inf. लषितुम्),
to wish, desire, long for (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. (mostly with prep. अभि);
to strive after, approach (acc.), VarBṛS., Sch. :
Caus., or cl. 10. P. लाषयति (aor. अलीलषत्), to exercise an art, Dhātup. xxxiii, 55 (v.l. for लश्) :
Desid. लिलषिषति Gr.:
Intens. लालष्यते, लालष्टि, ib.
लस् [cf. Lat. lascivus, lascivire.]
2. लस् mfn. shining, glittering (see अ-लस्).
लश m. gum, resin, L.
लस mfn. shining, playing, moving hither and thither (cf. अ-लस॑)
having the smell of bell-metal, L.
लस m. fever in a camel, L.
smell of bell-metal, L.
लस n. red sandalwood, L.
लसा f. saffron, turmeric, L.
लास m. the act of jumping, sporting, dancing, Ṛt. (cf. रास)
dancing as practised by women, L.
soup, broth (= यूष), L.
saliva (?), in अलास, q.v.
लास लासिन्, लास्य See p. 899, col. 2.
लशुन n. or (rarely) m. (Uṇ. iii, 57; sometimes written लसुन cf. रसुन) garlic, Gaut.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
one of the 10 kinds of onion, L.
लशुनीय mfn. garlicky, W.
लषण mfn. one who desires or longs for, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 150
लषणा-वती f. N. of a place, Cat.
लषित mfn. wished, desired &c., MBh.
लसित mfn. played, sported &c., MBh.
लष्व m. a dancer, actor, Uṇ. i, 153, Sch.
लषमण m. (= लक्ष्मण) N. of a man, Inscr.
लषमा-देवी f. = लक्ष्मी-देवी N. of a princess, Inscr.
लष्मि-देव m. N. of a chief (= लक्ष्मी-द्˚), Inscr.
लसक mfn. = लासक, L.
लसक m. a kind of tree, L.
लसक n. a partic. drug, L.
लासक mfn. moving hither and thither, playing, gamboling, L.
लासक m. a dancer, actor (with नर्तक, among the names of Śiva), R.
a peacock, L.
N. of a dancer, Kathās.
embracing, surrounding (वेष्ट), L.
लासक m. or n. a kind of weapon, Kād.
लासक n. a turret, tower, room on the top of a building (= अट्ट), L.
लसिका f. spittle, saliva, L.
a tendon, muscle, L. (cf. लसीका)
लसीका f. watery humour in the body, lymph, serum &c., Car.; Bhpr.
the juice of the sugarcane, L.
a tendon, muscle, L.
लासिका f. a female dancer, Kathās.; Vcar.
a harlot, wanton, L.
a kind of dramatic performance (= विलासिका), Sāh.
लासिक mfn. dancing, Śiś.
लसद्-अंशु mfn. (p. लसत् + अ˚) having flashing or glancing rays (as the sun), MW.
लस्त mfn. embraced, grasped, W.
skilled, skilful, ib.
लस्त लस्तक &c. See above.
लस्तक m. the middle of a bow (the part grasped), L.
लस्तक—ग्रह m. seizing the m˚ of a bow, L.
लस्तकिन् m. a bow, L.
लास—वती f. N. of a woman, Kathās.
लासकी f. a dancing girl, L.
लासक—युवन् m. a young dancer, L.
लासन n. moving hither and thither, MBh.
लासिन् mfn. moving to and fro, dancing, MW. (cf. रङ्ग-लासिनी).
लास्य m. a dancer, MārkP.
N. of a king, VP.
लास्या f. a dancing girl, L.
लास्याङ्ग n. a division of the Lāsya (cf. above).
लास्यक n. = लास्य, a dance, L.
लसोफरञ्ज m. or n. (?) N. of a place, Cat.
लस्पूजनी॑ f. a large needle, ŚBr.; KātyŚr. (here ibc. ˚नि),
लाषुक mfn. (√ लष्) covetous, greedy, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 154.
लास्फोटनी f. = आस्फोटनी, a gimlet, auger, L.
